NOTES AND LIMITATIONS
  - StackBroom is read-only: no process, container, image, volume or WSL distribution was changed.
  - Process memory is the Windows working set. Summed working sets can count shared pages more than once,
    so they are not unique memory; Unknown is never estimated.
  - Docker totals and reclaimable sizes are separate Docker reports. Reclaimable is Docker's estimate of what
    clean-up could free, not space already freed and not a guarantee.
  - WSL memory is the host-side utility VM figure; per-distribution use is not measurable from outside.
  - Project associations are evidence-based: "confirmed" needs a manifest on disk and a referenced path inside it.
  - Output policy: mode=default; command lines omitted; paths tokenised as %USERPROFILE%; secrets masked.
  - Scan notes:
      Docker: example note.
